summary.en: Iran-backed suspects are accused of plotting attacks on a U.K. air base that hosts U.S. jets in Iraq. A separate Iran-backed trio is linked to a drone strike on the Khor Mor gas field in Iraqi Kurdistan that halted production and cut power. Iraqi security officials announced expanded air defence deployments, the formation of a special security force and an energy police unit to combat oil smuggling and protect pipelines, and they are sending a delegation to Lebanon to assist the inquiry into former MP Ahmed al-Alwani’s death. 396 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Iran-støttede mistenkte blir anklaget for å ha planlagt angrep på en britisk flybase som huser amerikanske jagerfly i Irak. En separat Iran-støttet trio er knyttet til et droneram på gassfeltet Khor Mor i irakisk Kurdistan som stoppet produksjonen og kuttet strømmen. Iraks sikkerhetsmyndigheter kunngjorde utvidet luftforsvarsutplassering, opprettelse av en spesiell sikkerhetsstyrke og en energipoliti for å bekjempe oljesmugling og beskytte rørledninger, og de sender en delegasjon til Libanon for å bistå etterforskningen av tidligere stortingsrepresentant Ahmed al-Alwanis død. 396 kamprelaterte dødsfall ble registrert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Iraqi conflict
background.extract: The Iraqi conflict is a series of violent events that began with the 2003 American-led invasion of Iraq and deposition of Iraqi dictator Saddam Hussein, followed by a series of conflicts including the protracted Iraq War (2003–2011), the Iraqi insurgency (2011–2013), the War in Iraq (2013–2017), and most recently, the small-scale Islamic State insurgency in 4 provinces located in Northern Iraq since 2017.
